components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decision on a view: marquee amber, dark label, magnetic on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffb547; color: #121211; height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 15px/1 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e8962a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb547; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions: raised graphite with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: #1a1918; color: #f3efe8; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #302e2a; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); font: 600 14px/1 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #23221f; }
